scene: The glowing bao fills you with floaty energy above the transit docks.
picture: A flat side-scrolling transit wharf. The Pacific Islander man in floral shirt, sandals, top knot, holding his ukulele, floats slightly above the boards at centre. Far left sits a moored solar-sail junk. Up high hangs a glass cloud cable pod. Far right waits a sleek, glowing bullet train with open sliding doors.
shown: a solar-sail junk tied to the wooden dock on the far left
a round cloud cable pod hanging from its cable up high
a sleek neon bullet train with open doors on the far right
